title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Civic Center on 1982-08-06
lineage: Transfer: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A (Dolby-B in) > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 01/2019
source: Source: BeyerDynamic M88's > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-90's. Concert recording by Rip Tompkins, & with thanks to Richie Stankiewicz!

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording with rich Beyer sound capturing a classic Dead performance
ai_review.review: Capt. Greg raves about this audience tape, highlighting the warm richness of the Beyer‑mic capture and calling it a great find. While no specific songs are mentioned, the high praise suggests an enjoyable listening experience despite the lack of detailed show notes.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review enthusiastically praises the recording’s sound quality, but without musical details the rating leans on audio merit alone.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Rich, warm tone attributed to Beyer microphones; clear and immersive for an audience source with no notable flaws mentioned.
